messages:
Emma: Quick sync — we need cross-team alignment on SmartServe v1 launch criteria. Core asks: runtime hot-path changes, infra capacity, security review, and API contract bump. Can everyone confirm owners and blockers by EOD?

Raj: Runtime notes: we need ~2 weeks for perf validation on 8k context and KV cache tuning. Can start smoke tests tomorrow if infra can provide a staging GPU pool. Also: will require a togglable prefix/KV cache flag.

Li: Infra: we can carve a staging pool (up to 4x A40-equivalent) but need expected concurrency and sequence-length distribution. Who will own canary autoscale policy? Need rollback play if staging shows memory OOMs.

Sofia: Security: need threat model + dataflow diagram before we sign off. Is any customer PII in the request path for GA? If yes, pen test required (est ~2 weeks). Also need KMS key Ownership for logs. @Emma please confirm.

David: Platform: I can own the canary automation and feature-flag wiring. Plan to do traffic split + automatic fallback to a smaller model variant on infra/latency errors. Will add a flag `feature.smartserve_v1` with subflags for canary percent and KV cache enabled.

Olivia: Design: small UX changes for results UI; will freeze copy and show/hide experiments by Thursday. Need the final API contract for the new structured output.

Emma: Ownership summary (proposed): Product=Emma, Runtime=Raj, Infra=Li, Platform=David, Security=Sofia, Design=Olivia. Blockers right now: infra capacity, final perf numbers from runtime, and security signoff.

Raj: Proposed rollout policy snippet (for discussion):
```
canary:
  percent: 5
  duration_hours: 48
  metrics:
    p95_latency_ms: <200
    error_rate_pct: <0.5
fallback:
  route: model-small-v1
  notify: @oncall
```
This implies we need metric hooks from infra/monitoring and an alert channel.

Li: Confirming we can provision pool once we have target QPS and avg seq length. Example calc: if baseline QPS=2000 and canary=5% -> canary QPS=100 => ~1 GPU for canary but need headroom for spikes. Put exact numbers in a follow-up. Also will add autoscale policy template.

Emma: Baseline QPS: 2000 (90th percentile traffic window). Canary target: 100 qps. Sequencing I propose: perf validation -> infra staging pool -> security docs/pen test -> canary rollout -> GA. Target GA date = in 4 weeks if no major blockers.

Sofia: We'll start pen test request today; need dataflow doc link and list of endpoints. If PII = no, pen test can be scoped lighter; else full cert.

David: I'll add the feature flag and a canary autoscale policy to infra repo today. Will depend on Li for pool provisioning. Also, I'll add rate-limiting guard rails to protect upstream models.

Olivia: UX handoff: I'll push assets to the design folder and post a link here when done.

deploy-bot: New staging pool request created: REQ-1234 (status: pending).

Emma: Action items before EOD: 1) Raj — perf validation plan + list of perf metrics (p50/p95/p99 latency, mem, tokens/sec). 2) Li — confirm pool size estimate and autoscale template. 3) Sofia — list required docs for security review. 4) David — draft feature-flag + rollback automation PR. 5) Olivia — final UX copy + API contract stub. I'll collect responses and publish a one-pager for launch criteria. Please ping me on slack or DM if anything blocks. Thanks!
